metadata.title: Role-Based Mailbox SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining trust boundaries, authority semantics, lifecycle governance, and accountability for role-based institutional email mailboxes.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, identity, records, and regulatory baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional email service providing mailboxes bound to formal organizational roles or offices rather than individual people, supporting continuity of authority across personnel changes.

information-type.title: Role-Based Email Content
information-type.description: Email messages sent or received by a mailbox representing an institutional role or office.

information-type.title: Role Assignment and Delegation State
information-type.description: Records defining which individuals are authorized to act on behalf of a role-based mailbox and for what duration.

information-type.title: Role Mailbox Audit Events
information-type.description: Audit trails binding mailbox actions to individual actors and role authority context.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Role-Based Mailbox Service inherits Shared Mailbox SSPP constraints and models with additional authority and lifecycle semantics.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Role-Based Mailbox Service is implemented on the Secure Email Platform.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: Role-based mailboxes exist to represent formal institutional roles or offices, not individual persons or casual shared use.

props.name: identity-scope
props.remarks: The mailbox identity is bound to an institutional role or office and persists across personnel changes.

props.name: role-definition-requirement
props.remarks: Each role-based mailbox MUST correspond to a formally defined institutional role with documented authority.

props.name: role-assignment-model
props.remarks: Assignment of individuals to act on behalf of a role-based mailbox MUST be explicit, time-bound, and independently revocable.

props.name: volume-constraint
props.remarks: Role-based mailboxes MUST NOT be used for bulk, mass, or campaign-style messaging.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Role-based mailboxes MUST NOT be used as application inboxes or automated messaging endpoints.

props.name: external-forwarding
props.remarks: External forwarding from role-based mailboxes is prohibited under all circumstances.

props.name: authority-scope
props.remarks: Email sent from a role-based mailbox represents the authority of the role, not the personal authority of the acting individual.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All actions taken via a role-based mailbox MUST be attributable to the individual actor and the role context.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Role-based mailboxes MUST NOT be used to transmit or store information classified at Level 4 or higher.

props.name: information-use-constraint
props.remarks: Role-based mailboxes are not authorized as repositories for long-term record storage.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Mailbox existence, access, and retention are governed by the lifecycle of the institutional role, not the individuals assigned.

props.name: disclosure-authority
props.remarks: Disclosure of role-based mailbox content occurs only under lawful or formally authorized institutional processes.

props.name: external-correspondence-constraint
props.remarks: Official correspondence conducted via role-based mailboxes MUST use institutional email addresses exclusively.

props.name: access-model
props.remarks: Shared and role-based mailboxes do not support direct login or authentication; all access occurs via delegated Send-As or Send-On-Behalf.

system-implementation.remarks: Role-based mailbox trust is enforced through role-governed assignment, strict delegation boundaries, per-actor attribution, and centralized monitoring.

components.title: Role-Based Email Mailbox
components.description: Mailbox representing an institutional role or office with controlled assignment and auditable authority.

roles.title: Role Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable authority for defining the role, approving mailbox use, and assigning personnel.

roles.title: Role-Based Mailbox Operator
roles.remarks: Authorized individual acting on behalf of the institutional role.

control-implementation.remarks: All controls applicable to role-based mailboxes are inherited from the Shared Mailbox SSPP and Secure Email Platform SSPP, with added authority and lifecycle constraints.
